class: Decorative radio overlay blocks native input
symptom: The previously-worked question timed out despite a supported No answer.
root_cause: Native set_checked failed on a covered input; the fallback clicked that same covered input and raised before reaching any recovery.
why_tests_missed: Radio fixtures exposed native inputs without the decorative layers present in Workday.
fix: Use the input's own associated label after native set_checked fails; do not search unrelated labels or click twice.
prevention: Verify the actual checked state and untouched adjacent choices with a covered-input browser fixture.
